generator.purpose: Turn user inputs into usable, copyable local output.
checks: Generation responds to inputs, copy works, and reset is available.
Local generation does not claim to call an AI service.

directory.purpose: Search, filter, and explore a structured collection.
checks: Search and combined filters work; no-results and reset states exist.
Detail slugs are backed by sample records and included in the route manifest.

quiz.purpose: Collect answers and return explainable results.
checks: Back, next, validation, result mapping, and restart work.
Direct result navigation without answers shows a recoverable empty state.

toolkit.purpose: Organize usable tools, checklists, and downloadable resources.
checks: Included tools work and downloads contain actual useful content.

content-hub.purpose: Publish organized, readable educational or editorial material.
checks: Every article card has substantive content and an existing route.
Quotes, media, and factual claims have supplied provenance or are omitted.

landing-page.purpose: Communicate the offer and complete the primary CTA.
checks: Primary CTA reaches a real local flow or a verified destination.
No invented testimonials, business statistics, partner logos, or urgency timers.

media-hub.purpose: Browse shows, episodes, and creator resources.
checks: Media cards use supplied licensed media or clearly labeled samples.
Missing media has an honest fallback without dead playback controls.

calculator.purpose: Calculate transparent illustrative scenarios from validated inputs.
checks: Formula tests cover zero, invalid, boundary, and representative inputs.
Units, rounding, assumptions, and estimate limitations are visible.

portal.purpose: Organize role-specific records and account workflows.
checks: Demo roles are labeled and never described as secure authorization.
Live mode requires tested server-side authentication and role checks.

dashboard.purpose: Explore sample operational data and complete local actions.
checks: Metrics derive from the same sample records as tables.
Filters and defined local mutations update relevant views.

portfolio.purpose: Showcase a person, studio, or collection of projects.
checks: Every showcased project opens a populated page or verified destination.

funnel.purpose: Guide users through a validated sequence with an explicit completion state.
checks: Validation and back navigation preserve appropriate inputs.
Demo submission never claims a real application, payment, or message was sent.

booking.purpose: Demonstrate consultation selection and booking details.
checks: Date, time zone, availability, and validation are consistent.
Demo confirmation cannot be mistaken for a reserved appointment.

learning-platform.purpose: Browse lessons and track sample learning progress.
checks: Lessons and assessments work with sample content.
Progress persistence and any demo certificates are clearly described.

developer-portal.purpose: Document an API and demonstrate requests using fixtures.
checks: Examples are consistent with the documented schema.
Demo keys and responses are synthetic; no live keys are generated.

catalog.purpose: Explore products and demonstrate selection or cart behavior.
checks: Product filters, quantity changes, and cart totals work.
Demo checkout does not process or claim a real payment.

community.purpose: Explore groups, discussions, and sample participation flows.
checks: Demo posts remain local and cannot imply delivery to real members.
Live mode requires access control and moderation workflows.

requirements: Use relative asset paths suitable for portfolio hosting.
Prefer local assets and deterministic fixtures.
Create real files for additional routes; a build step is optional and must be justified.
Resolve compatible versions during scaffolding and commit the lockfile.
Define dev, build, lint, typecheck, and relevant test scripts.
Do not install authentication, database, or payment integrations solely because a dashboard UI exists.

stages.goal: Convert one resolved brief into a complete project specification.
stages.completion: All source requirements are mapped to a route, component, working behavior, demo integration, or explicit deferred item. Resolve file collisions and framework choice before scaffolding.

stages.goal: Generate inspectable Windows scaffold and GitHub scripts from the manifest.
stages.completion: Scripts accept explicit parameters, stop on native command errors, and cannot overwrite an unrelated project or publish without the configured delivery settings.

stages.goal: Create the selected starter and establish local verification commands.
stages.completion: Project root and Git top level match; starter runs; dependency versions and lockfile are recorded where applicable.

stages.goal: Implement brand tokens, layout, navigation, reusable components, and sample-data contracts.
stages.completion: Shared layout renders at desktop and mobile widths and every navigation destination is accounted for.

stages.goal: Build the primary page and functional user journey.
stages.completion: The primary CTA and core behavior work end to end using the declared local or demo data mode.

stages.goal: Complete remaining content, details, and secondary interactions.
stages.completion: Every planned route has complete content and meaningful loading, empty, error, and success states where relevant.

stages.goal: Complete demo adapters or explicitly configured live integrations.
stages.completion: Each integration has an implementation mode and evidence; demo submissions do not claim external delivery.

stages.goal: Run independent build, behavior, route, and browser checks and bounded repair passes.
stages.completion: Required checks pass, or failures are recorded and the run remains incomplete. No success based solely on an agent summary.

stages.goal: Optionally create a private GitHub repository and push the verified source.
stages.completion: When enabled, remote owner/name, visibility, and pushed commit are verified. Otherwise record skipped-by-configuration.

stages.goal: Document operation and prepare a portfolio import candidate.
stages.completion: Record actual paths, verification evidence, source-publication state, and demo limitations. Deployment URL remains null unless verified.
